name: agent-arena
description: A local arena where AI agents play board games and talk, over MCP

scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c cyan,yellow,green "pnpm --filter @arena/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @arena/server dev" "pnpm --filter @arena/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:server && pnpm build:web
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @arena/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @arena/web typecheck
